full_judgment: 2. The case before this Court has its roots in Pre-emption Miscellaneous Case No. 45 of 1987 filed by the Pre-emptor-Opposite Party No. 1. The Pre-emptor's case is that three brothers Ledu, Felu Munshi and Yakub Ali were owners of land in S.A. Khatian No. 359, and that subsequently, Ledu and Felu Munshi sold their respective shares to Yakub Ali. Upon Yakub Ali's demise his widow, the Pre-emptor-Opposite Party No. 1 Anwara Khatun, amongst others, became a co-sharer by inheritance in the said land. Yakub Ali also had a sister named Samina who died leaving behind one daughter Suratunnessa and three sons. It is the Pre-emptor's case that Samina's descendants subsequently sold the case land to the Pre-emptee on 29.4.1987 without prior notice to the Pre-emptor. Upon subsequent knowledge of the said transfer on 20.9.1987 the Pre-emptor took steps to file the pre-emption case.
